scope: Measured observations and saved fitted predictions/parameters; no analysis contrasts or plots.
limitations: Benchmark rows retain language-level scores and counts; paired-example/bootstrap analyses require original item scores.
Saved coefficients cover all 30 refitted laws and optimizer controls; historical coefficients keep their original scope.
Training steps and physical cost summaries cover the main A-D grid.
Routing sequence-block counts are omitted; routing bootstrap intervals require the full package.
Training iterations retain LM loss, learning rate and tokens; detailed step telemetry is omitted.
Detailed source-file provenance is in the full package manifest, identified by parent_manifest_sha256.

training_runs.grain: one physical training job; additive GPU-hour totals

training_steps.grain: one recorded training iteration, including identifiable restart duplicates

hardware.grain: recorded MFU denominator and hardware contract

seed_comparison.grain: one seed-study checkpoint x language; seed 1234 reuses main-grid observations

language_composition.grain: one composition arm x seed x checkpoint x evaluated language

composition_normalization.grain: recorded old/new unigram reference per common language

fit_predictions.grain: one revision x optimizer arm x fitted model x fold x scored observation

fit_parameters.grain: one revision x optimizer arm x model x fold x shared or language parameter

fit_membership.grain: exact training/test readout, trajectory and scoring-language membership by revision and fold

benchmarks.grain: one checkpoint x benchmark x evaluation language

routing_counts.grain: one checkpoint x language x layer; real-token and padding expert counts

routing_losses.grain: one corrected routing checkpoint x language loss

learning_rate.grain: one cluster x seed x configuration x learning-rate candidate

fit_status.grain: fit/scoring certification and numerical protocol by revision, model, fold, arm and case

limitations: Batch size is fixed per architecture; 56 failed jobs use aligned padding (multiple 8), others use multiple 1.
Native parity checks scoring correctness within the selected shape; a single-rank replica check is not evidence of independent run reproducibility.
No cross-batch or cross-padding numerical invariance claim; small classification rankings and one Taxi1500 sign change.
Paper bootstrap intervals and example transition figures must be recomputed from H100 item scores; they are outside the language-level package.

Fresh inspection checked all job specs, hardware, launch success and recorded diagnostics; it relies on the sealed collector for complete item reduction, without rescoring or rereading all 131 GiB of item scores.

fit_revision.historical_selection: RN13 remains the historical inner-selected form; refitting does not rerun selection.
